description: This file defines a LightningJS component named 'Loader' which displays animated circles as a loading indicator. It imports external LightningJS modules, manages internal state for animation alpha transparency, and includes lifecycle hooks and methods for animation control.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: A LightningJS component representing a loading spinner with animated circles.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins an interval to animate the opacity (alpha) of the circles, creating a fading effect.
